lokasi: a bright Indonesian junior high school classroom during an exam: rows of wooden desks, exam papers and pencils, a green chalkboard at the front, windows with morning sunlight on the left.

serial.pesan: Nilai jujur lebih berharga dari nilai sempurna

youtube.title: Diajak Nyontek Pas Ujian | Uwais Hijrah #3
youtube.description:
Teman sebangku menyodorkan contekan saat ujian. Uwais pilih yang mana?

Kejujuran membawa kepada kebaikan, dan kebaikan membawa ke surga. (HR. Bukhari 6094, Muslim 2607)

Hari 3 dari 30.

#30HariUwaisHijrah #JOTA #shorts

shots.title: Cheat sheet slides over
shots.figuran: CLASSMATE: a faceless 15-year-old Indonesian boy, Uwais's deskmate, white short-sleeved school shirt and grey trousers, short straight black hair, sitting on Uwais's right

dialog.text: [whispering] Gampang sih, tinggal lihat... [pause] tapi Allah lihat aku.

shots.adegan: During an exam, Uwais sits at his wooden desk on the left with his exam paper and pencil; his classmate on the right quietly slides a small folded cheat sheet across the desk toward Uwais's hand. Both are fully visible from a front three-quarter angle.
shots.gerak: The classmate slowly pushes the folded paper closer to Uwais. Uwais pauses his pencil, looks down at the paper, then lifts his head slightly toward the window as if thinking.
shots.akhir: Uwais sits still with his hand resting next to the folded paper, the classmate beside him on the right.
shots.suara: Pencils scratching on paper, a clock ticking softly, a page turning.

shots.title: Paper pushed back
shots.figuran: CLASSMATE: a faceless 15-year-old Indonesian boy, Uwais's deskmate, white short-sleeved school shirt and grey trousers, short straight black hair, sitting on Uwais's right

dialog.text: [calm] Nggak usah, ya. [determined] Nilai jujur lebih berharga dari nilai sempurna.

shots.adegan: Uwais and his classmate sit side by side at the same desk, Uwais on the left.
shots.gerak: Uwais gently pushes the folded paper back to the classmate with two fingers, gives a small polite nod, then bends over his own exam paper and writes his answer with steady pencil strokes.
shots.akhir: Uwais writes on his own paper; the classmate holds the folded paper, sitting on the right.
shots.suara: Paper sliding on wood, pencils scratching, a clock ticking.

shots.title: Empty classroom
shots.narration: [calm] Kejujuran membawa kepada kebaikan, dan kebaikan membawa ke surga. HR. Bukhari dan Muslim.
shots.adegan: The empty classroom after the exam: neat rows of wooden desks, one finished exam paper with a pencil on a desk, warm sunlight streaming through the windows across the floor.
shots.gerak: Dust particles float in the warm sunbeams; the camera slowly glides forward along the row of desks toward the finished exam paper.
shots.suara: A quiet room tone, birds outside the window, a soft breeze.

shots.title: Walking out relieved

dialog.text: [relieved] Hari ketiga, lulus! [curious] Besok: ada kembalian jajan yang kelebihan...

shots.lokasi: a bright school corridor outside the classroom: a long tiled hallway, green classroom doors, a window row with morning light, a small courtyard tree outside.
shots.adegan: Uwais walks out of the classroom door into the bright corridor, hugging two books against his chest with both arms, alone, fully visible from a front three-quarter angle.
shots.gerak: Uwais walks forward slowly along the corridor, lets out a relieved breath with a small shrug of his shoulders, and lifts his head toward the morning light.
shots.akhir: Uwais stands in the corridor hugging his books, facing slightly toward the camera.
shots.suara: Distant school chatter, footsteps on tiles, birds outside.
